title: Add .autoDispose to points_providers.dart's family providers
why: Both are classic (non-@riverpod) family providers with no `.autoDispose` -- in this Riverpod version, a manually-declared provider not marked autoDispose is kept alive for the container's lifetime once first read. Because CurriculumId is a small finite enum, the leak is bounded (at most ~15-20 cached results per provider), so the practical memory cost is small, but it's inconsistent with every other parameterized provider this same feature declares (achievementsOverviewProvider, _pointConfigDataProvider, pendingRedemptionsProvider are all explicitly .autoDispose), suggesting an oversight rather than a deliberate choice.
recommendation: Add `.autoDispose` to both curriculumPointsProvider and pointsHistoryProvider.
acceptance_criteria: Both family providers in points_providers.dart are declared with .autoDispose

corrections: Line 61 citation for pointsHistoryProvider is off by one (quoted factory text is on line 62; 61 is the var name). Also achievementsOverviewProvider/_pointConfigDataProvider/pendingRedemptionsProvider are plain zero-arg autoDispose providers, not actually parameterized/family — the "inconsistent with every other parameterized provider" framing overstates that comparison, though the underlying SM-6 violation stands on its own.
